sources: PLACEHOLDER: common bench practice for dead and not-charging phones; thresholds and priors are invented for development.
Used when no model pack matches; the agent says it is working without model data.

meaning.en: no current at all: open power path, power key line or a bad boot cable
meaning.hi: current bilkul nahi: power path open, power key line, ya boot cable kharab

meaning.en: high current at once without pressing power: short on the battery line
meaning.hi: power dabaye bina turant zyada current: battery line pe short

meaning.en: current rises then drops back: the board starts and stops (processor, memory or software)
meaning.hi: current badhta hai phir gir jata hai: board start hoke ruk jata hai (processor, memory ya software)

meaning.en: normal start-up current: not a power fault
meaning.hi: normal start-up current: power fault nahi

meaning.en: current sits at the supply limit: hard short, disconnect
meaning.hi: current limit pe atka hai: hard short, disconnect karo

probe_note.en: Red probe on ground, black on the VBAT pin
probe_note.hi: Red probe ground pe, black VBAT pin pe

label.en: Power key line at the side button
label.hi: Side button pe power key line

probe_note.en: Red probe on ground, black on the power key pad
probe_note.hi: Red probe ground pe, black power key pad pe

probe_note.en: Red probe on ground, black on the VBUS pin
probe_note.hi: Red probe ground pe, black VBUS pin pe

label.en: diode reading at the battery connector VBAT pin
label.hi: battery connector VBAT pin pe diode reading

label.en: diode reading on the power key line
label.hi: power key line pe diode reading

label.en: current drawn through the charging port
diode reading at the charging port VBUS pin
label.hi: charging port VBUS pin pe diode reading

fix.en: Find the shorted part on the battery line (heat or rosin check).
fix.hi: Battery line pe short part dhoondo (heat ya rosin check).

trainee.en: Something on the battery line is shorted to ground.
trainee.hi: Battery line pe kuch ground se short hai.

expert.en: VBAT short: immediate draw, near-zero diode reading.
expert.hi: VBAT short: turant draw, diode lagbhag zero.

name.en: Hard short that holds the supply at its limit
name.hi: Hard short jo supply ko limit pe rakhta hai

fix.en: Disconnect, then locate the hard short with a heat check at low current.
fix.hi: Disconnect karo, phir kam current pe heat check se hard short dhoondo.

trainee.en: The short is so strong the supply hits its limit.
trainee.hi: Short itna strong hai ki supply limit pe pahunch jaati hai.

expert.en: Dead short: supply in current limit.
expert.hi: Dead short: supply current limit mein.

fix.en: Find the open part between the connector and the board (coil or fuse).
fix.hi: Connector aur board ke beech open part dhoondo (coil ya fuse).

trainee.en: Battery current cannot reach the board.
trainee.hi: Battery current board tak nahi pahunchta.

expert.en: Open on VBAT: no draw, connector reads OL.
expert.hi: VBAT open: draw nahi, connector OL.

name.en: Faulty boot cable or supply lead
name.hi: Boot cable ya supply lead kharab

fix.en: Replace or re-seat the boot cable and check the supply leads.
fix.hi: Boot cable badlo ya theek se lagao, supply leads check karo.

trainee.en: The cable may not reach the board at all.
trainee.hi: Cable shayad board tak pahunch hi nahi rahi.

name.en: Fault on the power key line

trainee.en: The power key signal never reaches the power IC.
trainee.hi: Power key ka signal power IC tak nahi pahunchta.

name.en: Boot failure after power-up (processor, memory or software)
name.hi: Power-up ke baad boot fail (processor, memory ya software)

fix.en: Beyond the power path: needs a technician (processor, memory or software).
fix.hi: Power path ke aage ka fault: technician chahiye (processor, memory ya software).

trainee.en: The board starts, then stops before it finishes booting.
trainee.hi: Board start hota hai, phir boot poora hone se pehle ruk jata hai.

expert.en: Rise-then-drop: power path fine, boot stage fails.
expert.hi: Rise-then-drop: power path theek, boot stage fail.

trainee.en: No current gets in through the port.
trainee.hi: Port se current andar nahi aata.

name.en: Failed part in the charging path

fix.en: Check the charging-path parts after the port.
fix.hi: Port ke baad charging path ke parts check karo.

trainee.en: The port is fine but charging current stops after it.
trainee.hi: Port theek hai par charging current uske baad ruk jata hai.

name.en: Board fine: cable or charger at fault
name.hi: Board theek: cable ya charger kharab

fix.en: Try a known-good cable and charger.
fix.hi: Achha cable aur charger try karo.

trainee.en: The board charges normally from a good supply.
trainee.hi: Achhi supply se board normal charge hota hai.

diode_mode.en: Diode mode shows the voltage drop across a junction, in volts.
diode_mode.hi: Diode mode junction ka voltage drop dikhata hai, volt mein.

boot_current.en: Boot current is the current the board draws when it is powered and switched on.
boot_current.hi: Boot current woh current hai jo board power aur switch on hone pe leta hai.

vbat.en: VBAT is the main supply line from the battery connector into the board.
vbat.hi: VBAT battery connector se board mein jaane wali main supply line hai.

current_limit.en: The current limit caps how much current the supply will give, which protects the board.
current_limit.hi: Current limit supply ka maximum current hai, jo board ko bachata hai.

short.en: A short is a near-zero resistance path to ground.
short.hi: Short matlab ground tak lagbhag zero resistance ka raasta.

ol.en: OL means open: no connection between the probes.
ol.hi: OL matlab open: probes ke beech connection nahi.
